# Compass Lab Index {#sec-appendix-b}

This index lists every hands-on lab in the book: 71 labs in Chapters 1 to 21, 17 of them required (each is run in a class session) and 54 optional. Chapters 22 and 23 have no labs. Each row repeats what the lab's own page states: its time, whether it is required, and what you need. The full steps, expected observations and debrief questions are in the chapter's Hands-on Labs section and in the lab sheet.

**How to read the table.** *Time* is the lab sheet's own estimate; where a shorter version exists, it is named. *Status* follows the lab sheet and the syllabus: required labs are part of a class session; optional labs are practice. Labs in Deep chapters (6, 13 and 17) and labs marked Deep are not examinable (decision D20). *What you need* names the kinds of tools, never a product: tool neutrality is a rule of this book, and current tools and click paths live in Compass. "No-device route stated" means the lab sheet offers a way to do it without your own device or an AI account, usually with printed, dated sample outputs.

**Compass.** Compass, the book's digital companion, is optional, free and ungraded for UT Dallas students; grades and submissions stay in eLearning, and every lab can be done from the book. Each row's last column will carry a short link to the lab's Compass page; until the links exist, it reads "In Compass (optional): link to be added".
